title: enlightenviz board
description:
A dashboard: named queries, filters, figures and charts that draw their
results. One board is one YAML file.

board.description:
The id of the board; part of the URL of its queries. Unique across the
boards directory. Letters, digits, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter
or `_`, at most 63 characters.

charts.description: The charts of the board, in the order they are shown. At least one.

filters.description:
The filters shown above the board, in order. Each one drives the
parameter of its name in every query that declares it.

queries.description:
The queries of the board, by name. The name is part of the URL, and has
the same form as the id of a board.

stats.description: The figures shown above the charts: one value of one query each.

text.description: Optional text shown under the title.

title.description: The title shown above the board.

Chart.description:
A chart: an Apache ECharts option that draws the result of a query. The
option carries no data: the page adds the rows of the query.

echarts.description:
An Apache ECharts option, kept as it is. `validate` refuses data and
links in it, and checks that the columns `encode`, `dimensions` and
`visualMap` name are columns of the query.

palette.description: The colours the series take: `categorical` (default) or `ordered`.

query.description: The name of the query this chart draws; a key of `queries`.

Control.description: How a filter is drawn and what it lets the visitor choose.

oneOf.description: One value out of the options; for a scalar parameter.
Any number of the options, at least one; for a list parameter.
A calendar date; for a `date` parameter.

Filter.description: A control above the board that sets one parameter.

control.description:
How the filter is drawn. It must fit the type of the parameter:
`select` for text, integer, number or boolean, `multiselect` for a
list, `date` for a date.

label.description: The label shown with the control.

options.description:
For `select` and `multiselect`: the options as a fixed list. Give this
or `options_from`, not both. A `date` filter has neither.

options_from.description:
For `select` and `multiselect`: take the options from a query of this
board, run once without parameters.

param.description: The parameter this filter sets, in every query that declares it.

FilterOption.description: One fixed option of a filter.

label.description: The text shown to the visitor.

value.description:
The value sent as the parameter: a quoted string for text and dates, a
number for integer and number, `true` or `false` for boolean.

OptionsFrom.description: Where the options of a filter come from.

label.description: The column that holds the text shown to the visitor.

query.description:
A query of this board. It is run without parameters, so every
parameter it declares needs a default.

value.description: The column that holds the value sent as the parameter.

Palette.description: Which colours a chart takes its series from.

oneOf.description: The eight categorical colours, in their fixed order (the default).

The four-step blue ramp, weakest to strongest, for classes that have
an order.

default.description:
The value used when a request gives none, of the declared type: a
quoted string for `text` and `date`, a number for `integer` and
`number`, `true` or `false` for `boolean`, and a YAML list of those for
the list types. A parameter without a default is required.

max_items.description:
For list types only: the most items a request may give. Default 100,
at most 1000.

oneOf.description: Any text, without a NUL character. Sent to Postgres as `text`.
A whole number in the range of a 64-bit signed integer (`bigint`).

Query.description: One SQL query and the typed parameters it accepts.

params.description:
The parameters of the query, by name. A name has the form
`[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*`, at most 63 characters.

sql.description:
One SQL statement, a `SELECT` or a `WITH ... SELECT`. Write a parameter
as `$name`; every parameter declared in `params` must be used, and
every `$name` must be declared. Do not write `$1`. A single trailing
`;` is allowed.

Stat.description:
A figure shown above the charts: one column of the single row a query
returns.

format.description: How the number is written. Without it, up to two decimals.

hero.description: The headline figure of the board, drawn larger. At most one stat.

label.description: The label shown with the number.

query.description: The name of the query; a key of `queries`. It must return one row.

value.description: The column that holds the number.

StatFormat.description: How a stat's number is written.

oneOf.description: A whole number with thousands separators: 12,345.
A short form for large numbers: 12.3K, 4.5M.
